title: Distinct microbial signatures and their predictive value in recurrent acute pancreatitis: insights from 5-region 16S rRNA gene sequencing
summary: Random-forest microbial features predicted pancreatitis recurrence in a prospective cohort, and the study tested a selected taxon in mice.
ai_technology: Prospective 90-patient cohort was split into training and validation groups; random forest assessed recurrence prediction and an animal experiment followed.

evidence.tested: Random-forest microbial features predicted pancreatitis recurrence in a prospective cohort, and the study tested a selected taxon in mice.
evidence.unknown: The result is limited to the reported dataset, experimental setting and validation in this study; broader generalization and real-world benefit are not established.
